description: Creates a price alert for the signed-in user: one email when a metric at an ERCOT settlement point is above or below a threshold on each of the last N delivery days (default 3), checked each morning, then quiet for 7 days. Metrics: tb4 (4-hour day-ahead battery spread, USD/MWh, the default), rt_tb4, dam_avg, negative_hours (day-ahead hours below zero per day), rt_spikes (real-time hours above $100 per day). Pass settlement_point (HB_HOUSTON, LZ_WEST, a resource node) or an address or lat/lng to use the nearest node. Use when the user asks to be told, alerted or notified about prices, negative prices or spikes. Only call it when the user asked. Pass id (from list_price_alerts) to change one. Pro and up, 25 alerts; free accounts get an explanation and nothing is saved.

address.description: Texas address; the nearest settlement point is used.

days.description: Consecutive delivery days the condition must hold. Default 3, 1 to 30.

op.description: gt = above the threshold (default), lt = below.

settlement_point.description: ERCOT settlement point, e.g. HB_NORTH, LZ_SOUTH, FO_FORMOSG6.

site_id.description: Optional watched site id (from list_saved_sites) to tie the alert to; removing the site turns the alert off.

threshold.description: Level to cross, in the metric's unit.

name: set_price_alert
title: Email me when a node's prices cross a level (Pro)
